subject.title: [Feature]: Load macOS onboarding providers from Gateway catalog

question: Should the macOS onboarding API-key picker consume the Gateway/provider setup catalog now, and what additive response shape should the app rely on for provider labels, hints, starter models, and activation?
rationale: The issue has the protected `maintainer` label and changes a first-run UX/API boundary between the macOS app and Gateway, so automation should not choose the permanent product/protocol contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design the additive Gateway contract
options.body: Keep the issue open and have the likely owners agree on the catalog fields macOS should consume before implementation.

options.title: Defer macOS parity
options.body: Keep the current three-provider picker until the macOS onboarding surface is ready to consume broader provider catalog data.

options.title: Reject catalog-driven macOS setup
options.body: Close only after maintainers decide that non-hardcoded providers should remain outside guided macOS onboarding.

recommendation.title: Design the additive Gateway contract
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and have the likely owners agree on the catalog fields macOS should consume before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the recent merged macOS onboarding/setup direction and opened the follow-up issue, making them the best available owner for the app-side contract choice.
